scope: Complete validated Wikisource transcription of the anonymous English 1866 Joseph Masters edition: all 118 scan positions, covering printed cover, half-title, title, colophon, Liturgy, Order as performed in the Great Church and in the Holy Mountain of Athos, diagram/key and seal; nine blank scan positions accounted, running heads excluded as navigation.
